::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
One of India's pioneering fabless semiconductor companies. Designed India's first indigenously developed 4G/LTE and 5G NR modem chipsets.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Multi-standard wireless modem SoCs supporting 4G LTE-Advanced and 5G NR. Targets telecom infrastructure and CPE (Customer Premises Equipment) applications.
